fixed_statement:
Let \(M\) be modular.
Let \(p\) be a valuated quotient of \(M\).

The valuated quotient \(p\) is equivalently a valuated matroid on the modular lattice \(\cL(M)\), with coordinates indexed by flats of the corresponding rank.
fixed_proof: By Proposition 3, \(p\) descends to flat-valued coordinates. The standard modular-lattice form of valuated matroids identifies these descended coordinates with valuated matroids on \(\cL(M)\).
